name: kf_map_group
code:
import re
ms = list(re.finditer(r'([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', 'ab-12 cd-34'))
print(list(map(lambda m: m.group(2), ms)))

name: kf_sorted_group
code:
import re
ms = list(re.finditer(r'([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', 'b2-a1 x9-c3'))
print([m.group(1) for m in sorted(ms, key=lambda m: m.group(1))])

name: kf_filter_span
code:
import re
ms = list(re.finditer(r'([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', 'ab-12 cd-345'))
print([m.span() for m in filter(lambda m: m.group(2) == '345', ms)])

name: kf_min_group

import re
ms = list(re.finditer(r'([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', 'cd-34 ab-12'))
